tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal thugs rjes khros pas gshin rje gshed// mi bzad khro bo rgya cher rnam rol pa// bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub thabs man ngag ji bzhin bshad// de la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pas rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgom par bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dhīḥdamar ser cig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'jam dpal zhi khro'i lha tshogs/ bla ma steng gi cha la bzhugs pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ de la yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// la sogs pas rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// la sogs pa lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor bsgom/

oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba bsam/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu yang zhing g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa bsam/ de'i steng du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su thod pa brtsegs pa'i rwa ba keng rus kyis phub pa'i nang du/ khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du yi ge dhīḥs mtshan pa'i utpa la bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pa las rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur par bsgom/ de'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pa na ral gri g.yon pa na utpa la 'dzin pa/ rin po ches brgyan cing dar gyi na bza' gsol ba zhi ba'i skur bsam/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang lha mo thams cad spyan drangs rang la thim pas/ thams cad zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung*/ ā li kā li dang gsang sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ nyi ma'i steng du 'dus nas 'dres pa las byung ba'i hūm̐ yig nag po/ 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa cig tu gyur par bsam/ yang de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam pas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ la thim nas 'dres pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse mo dgu pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/ de las khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas/ sems can thams cad gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sems can thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur/

tshur 'dus rdo rje la thim nas yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur par bsam/ de'ang padma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma he khros pa'i gdan la/ zhabs g.yas pa brkyang zhing g.yon pa bskum pas bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog mthing nag rtsa ba'i zhal ma he'i gdong pa/ g.yas kyi zhal dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug g.yon gyi dang pos khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa gnyis ka'ang thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwā?ṃ ga phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon brgyangs nas na bzar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ sbrul nag gi chun po'i mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil zhing*/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du bsgoms nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas brtan par bya'o// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yum dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ mchod pas sngar bzhin du mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ oṃ badzra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chus rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/

de nas dbang gi lha nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du bdag la thim par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de nas rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang*/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ sngon po bsgoms nas/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsum du bca' zhing*/ hrīḥṣṭ+rī'i sngags re re brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun du bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ lce la myangs pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsgom zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta'i sngags brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rang gi lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis rang gi pang du yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog nag mo// gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gsal bar dmigs nas/ de dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bkug zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zhu/ bha gar babs pa mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med par gyur/ de phyir spros nas de rnams kyis 'di skad ces/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// longs spyod yul du du mar snang*// shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no// 'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la// rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol// gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la// dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod// reg bya 'gag pa med pa la// mi g.yo bzhin du rol du gsol// zhes gsung zhing mchod par bsam/ de nas yang de dag gis mgrin gcig tu/ hūm̐ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog 'od zer bye ba 'phro ba bzhengs// mtshan ma bsgreng ba ma he'i zhal// gnyis med sbyor bas khyod rgyal mdzad// zla ba bzhin du zhal dgu pa// lha dang lha min thams cad kun// ma lus par ni 'jigs par mdzad// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang brjid par gnas// stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod par bsam/

de nas mchod pa'i lha mo yum dang bcas pa rang gi lus la gnyis su med par thim par bsgoms nas/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de mnyam par gzhag go /de nas yid 'phro bar gyur na sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ gi mtha' mar/ yang snying dang*/ nye snying dang*/ de'i mtha' mar snying po dang*/ de'i mtha' mar rtsa sngags kyis bskor nas/ de rnams g.yas skor du 'khor bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bdag la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying gsum gang mos la bzlas par bya'o// bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba'i tshul ni/ 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis las/ 'das pa'i gtor ma gtang ba'i tshul ni/ gtor ma nye snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ āḥlas thod pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga'i steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rakta/ de'i steng du dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ hūm̐ bhrūm̐ ām̐ dzrīm̐ kham̐/ shar lho nas mtshams bzhir/ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐ bskyed nas/ de rnams las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sa bon dang bcas pa rnams zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod cing byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros nas/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed dang 'dra ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ de nas de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/

rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ya mānta ka sarba bighnān sha trūṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ la sogs pa dang*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// zhes pa la sogs pas mchod nas/ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog /la sogs pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ so so'i gnas nas phyogs skyong ba bcu bzhi bkug nas/ mdun gyi gshin rje gshed bskor nas bzhugs par bsam/ de rnams la padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ gyis gdan phul nas/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sarba bhū te bhyaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ bhakṣa sī ha ha hi hi phaiṃ phaiṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bdun nam gsum gyis dbul/ slar yang arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ de nas oṃ badzra muḥs 'das pa'i lha gshegs su gsol/ sarba bhū ta gatstshas 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol lo// gtor ma'i rim pa'o// kha zas pa'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi lus rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgom/ lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar nas/ me'i khrod na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis gtsor byas pa 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha'i tshogs rnams bzhugs par bsgoms nas/ de rnams la mchod pa'i bsam pas nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis longs spyad do// zas kyi bya ba'i rim pa'o// spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe bdag dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku/ brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi bsam pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin du bsams nas/

de thams cad kyang sna tshogs su snang yang rang bzhin med par stong par shes par byas la/ gang la yang sdang ba dang zhen pa med par longs spyad do// spyod lam mo// nyal ba'i tshe bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong par bsams la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis lha'i sku'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*// de dag gis ni rnal 'byor rdzogs par bstan zin to// //tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed par 'dod pa'i tshe/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bshams nas/ las kyi slob mas zhu dbul/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa dang bzlas pa gong du bstan pa ltar rdzogs par bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ yang snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par bskyed nas/ yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun du srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bdag gis bsgoms pa ltar/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar du mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas/ de'i mthar bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams nas/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa 'phros pas mdun du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams thogs nas mchod par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya byas la/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan dag /mchod yon gyis ni rab bkang ba// stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te// khro bo gshin rje gshed la dbul// oṃ ya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ gis zhal bsil dbul/ de bzhin du me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo rnams kyang so so'i sngags rnams snga ma dang sbyar la dbul lo// de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/

thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ de nas bla ma brgyud pa la dbul te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ dzñā na ā ka ra gupta/ padma badzra/ bla ma ye rang ba/ rwa lo tsa ba rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma chos rab/ bla ma ye shes seng ge bla ma 'bum seng*/ bla ma klog skya dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma mkhyen rab dam pa'i dpal zhes pa'i mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ bla ma rnams la dbul/ de nas rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying brjod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das la dbul/ de nas yi dam gyi lha gzhan la so so'i sngags kyis dbul/ de nas rang gi lce dang*/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar thig le byas la rang gi lus kyi lha mchod/ de nas chos skyong dang 'jig rten pa rnams la dbul lo// de nas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ gong du spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ phyi dang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// zhes pa la sogs pa brjod do// de nas bstod par bsam zhing*/ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog /la sogs pas bstod do// de nas gtor ma sbyangs nas/ dang po bcom ldan 'das la dbul/ gnyis pa chos skyong la dbul/ gsum pa 'di nyid kyi 'byung po'i gtor ma dbul/ bzhi pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la dbul/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bsags nas/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas las kyi slob ma rnams kyis bteg la/ lha dang bla ma dang der 'tshogs pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams la bstabs par bsam zhing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ de nas phud lha dang gtor ma la phul nas/ dam tshig drangs la/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tshim par longs spyad do// mthar lhag ma bsdus te lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin/

rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /la sogs pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams// gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo ni// shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis// ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces smon lam btab nas/ mdun bskyed gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces bzod par gsol nas/ mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na gshegs su gsol/ med na gshegs su gsol mi dgos/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol nas/ gtor ma rol mo dang bcas te gtang ngo*// de nas rang gi gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas bsrung*/ las kyi rjes bsdu'o// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga ste/ nye bar mkho ba thams cad rdzogs par bstan zin to// 'jam dpal khros pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// sgrub thabs rim pa rab tu gsal ba 'di// rgyal po'i bur gyur jim gyim zhes bya bas// gsol ba btab nas sngags 'chang 'phags pas sbyar// dge des 'gro kun rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// stobs kyis mi mthun phyogs las nyer rgyal nas// zag pa med pa'i dga' bde dam pa la// rnam pa kun tu dga' mgur rol par shog /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa phag gi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu dgu la sbyar ba'o// rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
